title: Q-SEED-did-it-work: seed did-it-work is planned; take it to built (SEED-LIFECYCLE-1)
body:

**Trigger:** every watchdog pass (seedlife --run)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation seedlife --probe did-it-work
**Status:** closed

SEED-LIFECYCLE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-21): a seed is built, deployed, verified live and wired into its loops, with a design goal of 365 days unattended. A plan is not a system.

What the next stages need, computed from evidence:

Gates it runs on (identity-bound, default in effect): payment.

Answers live in instances/did-it-work/lifecycle.json; build the code under the paths it names, deploy through the lane (doctrine/topology.json), and close each open survival class with a probe. Never edit the claim or this item to pass.

size: L

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-25T19:03:30Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github.
